name: MD5 checksums
description: Verifies .md5 sidecar files against the package they belong to.

codes.md5_postprocess.mismatch: A file did not match its recorded MD5.
codes.md5_postprocess.missing: None of the files an MD5 checksum file names is in the package.
codes.md5_postprocess.empty: An MD5 checksum file lists no checksum that could be read.
codes.md5_postprocess.unchecked: MD5 checksums matched, but {count} listed file(s) are not in this package and were not checked: {files}
